body.purpose: Interface copy, navigation, and beginner-facing explanations.

technical.purpose: Password-store paths, secrets, metadata, and command-adjacent values.

shadows.name: ambient-transient
shadows.purpose: Menus, popovers, and dialogs only; the incumbent system otherwise relies on borders and tonal layers.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.value: transition: color, background-color, border-color, box-shadow 150ms ease
motion.purpose: Brief, purposeful feedback for control state changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Explicit save, create, or confirm action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--primary, oklch(0.5 0.134 242.749)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.977 0.013 236.62)); font: 500 14px Inter Variable, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.46 0.134 242.749); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.5); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: oklch(0.42 0.134 242.749); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary entry actions such as edit, move, duplicate, and generate.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--background, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); font: 500 14px Inter Variable, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--accent, oklch(0.97 0 0)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.5); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { background: oklch(0.94 0 0); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Confirmed deletion or irreversible action only.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--destructive, oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325)); color: white; font: 500 14px Inter Variable, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: oklch(0.52 0.245 27.325); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.5); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-destructive:active { background: oklch(0.47 0.245 27.325); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Compact searchable or editable field with clear focus state.
components.css: .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--input, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); font: 400 14px Inter Variable, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); } .ds-input:focus { outline: 0; border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.5); }

components.name: Entry Value Group
components.description: Muted technical value container for a password, path, or metadata value.
components.css: .ds-value { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 8px; align-items: center; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius: 10px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted, oklch(0.97 0 0)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-value-label { grid-column: 1 / -1; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); font: 500 12px Inter Variable, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-value-code { overflow: hidden; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); font: 400 14px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-value-action { border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); font: 500 12px Inter Variable, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-value-action:hover { background: var(--accent, oklch(0.97 0 0)); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); } .ds-value-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outlined Card
components.description: Quiet grouping container for settings and bounded information.
components.html:
Store settings

Manage local password-store preferences.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)) 10%, transparent); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--card, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--card-foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 6px; font: 600 14px Inter Variable, sans-serif; } .ds-card-copy { margin: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); font: 400 14px/1.5 Inter Variable, sans-serif; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Two-pane workspace navigation with a restrained active state.
components.html: pass-gui
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 4px; width: 240px; padding: 12px; border-right: 1px solid var(--sidebar-border, oklch(0.922 0 0)); background: var(--sidebar, oklch(0.985 0 0)); } .ds-nav-brand { padding: 4px 8px 12px; color: var(--sidebar-foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); font: 600 14px Inter Variable, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { padding: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); font: 400 14px Inter Variable, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--sidebar-accent, oklch(0.97 0 0)); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground, oklch(0.205 0 0)); } .ds-nav-item-active { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, oklch(0.5 0.134 242.749)) 12%, transparent); color: var(--primary, oklch(0.5 0.134 242.749)); font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.5); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Pass GUI is a quiet local-first desktop workspace. White and near-white surfaces leave room for the password store itself; a cool work-blue marks intent, selection, and primary action without turning every control into an announcement. The visual language should feel dependable to experienced UNIX users and humane to newcomers.

Use low default density, strong grouping, and generous page breathing room. Technical values and paths switch to monospace as a precision cue; everything explanatory stays in Inter. Motion is brief and functional: reveal state, confirm action, or preserve spatial orientation, then disappear.
keyCharacteristics: Calm at rest; tactile under direct interaction.
One deliberate blue accent against neutral surfaces.
Monospace signals data, paths, secrets, and technical values.
Borders and tonal surfaces establish hierarchy; ambient lift is reserved for transient layers.
Advanced operations remain reachable without crowding primary workflows.

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: Workbench Blue is the only expressive accent. Use it for state and action; do not use it as broad decoration or a second background system.

rules.name: The Technical-Only Mono Rule
rules.body: Use monospace for information users may copy, inspect, or recognize from a terminal. Keep prose and navigation in Inter.

rules.name: The Lift-on-Arrival Rule
rules.body: Ambient shadow signals a layer that has arrived above current work. Do not add shadows to ordinary rows, cards, or page sections.

dos: Do keep primary blue limited to explicit action, active state, links, and focus.
Do use monospace for `pass` entry paths, values, secrets, and metadata.
Do group related actions with thin borders and muted surfaces before reaching for cards or shadows.
Do keep settings content within readable desktop measure instead of spreading controls edge to edge.
Do keep destructive actions visually distinct and named plainly.
donts: Don't introduce a second decorative accent color.
Don't put prose, navigation, or beginner-oriented help in monospace.
Don't add persistent shadows to cards, list rows, or ordinary form groups.
Don't make every advanced operation visible at equal weight to create, search, edit, and copy.
Don't use color as sole state or focus indicator.
